senses.gloss:
सृप् सृप् (akin to सृ), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 96, 9),
 1. To creep, Rām. 2, 59, 10.
 2. To go, to move, Hit. 30, 3.
 --With the prep. व्यति वि-अति, To move to and fro, MBh. 4, 1042.
 --With अनु अनु, To approach, MBh. 1, 6201.
 --With अप अप,
 1. To go away, MBh. 3, 14112.
 2. To run away, Rām. 2, 29, 4.
 3. To deviate from, Pañc. iii. d. 241 (अप-सर्प्य, anomal., or erroneously for अपसृप्य).
 4. To espy, Utt. Rāmac. 25, 5 (पौर-जानपदान्, the inhabitants of the town and district).
 --With व्यप वि-अप, To run away, MBh. 4, 1899.
 --With उद् उद्, To rise, Nal. 23, 9 (cf. यथासंगम्, under सङ्ग).
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To rise, Ragh. 6, 8.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To go near, to approach, Chr. 61, 40.
 2. To undergo, Hit. ii. d. 175.
 3. To go forth, Pañc. 159, 23; Man. 9, 269.
 4. To move, Hit. iv. d. 27.
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To approach, MBh. 1, 6450.
 --With परि परि, To go to and fro. Rām. 3, 52, 48.
 --With प्र प्र, To proceed, Pañc. 120, 9. प्रसृप्त, Come forth, Utt. Rāmac. 27, 6.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To sneak about, Pañc. ii. d. 48; to fly about, Hit. 16, 3, M.M.
 2. To spread, Mālat. 32, 4.
 3. To disperse, Nal. 1, 25.
 4. To flow to and fro on (acc.), Utt. Rāmac. 18, 7.
 5. To wind, to meander, Rām. 1, 44, 17.
 6. To run away, MBh. 1, 8286.
 --With सम् सम्, []
 1. To flow, Megh. 29.
 2. To glide, to move, Megh. 52.
 --Cf. Lat. serpere; ἔρπω; A.S. slipan.
सृपाट सृपाट, m., and f. टि, A measure.
सृपाटिका सृपाटिका, f. The beak of a bird.
सृप्र सृप् + र, m. The moon.
